Hero.label: Immersive Visual Novels
Hero.description:
We are Studio Elysian, creators of stories.
We create beautiful worlds that will move your heart.

Vision.label: Our Vision
Vision.title: Endless Horizons of Stories
Vision.p1: Studio Elysian is a team founded in 2022 that develops story-driven games combining visual, comic, illustration, and music elements.
Vision.p2: Our team members, each with strengths in their respective fields, come together with the goal of delivering stories that both users and creators can enjoy in various ways.
Vision.p3: Starting with "Memorial Circuit", we are developing the "Old Engine" universe centered on the theme of "war and its wounds," while also showcasing creative works like "In Between All Times" with unique worldviews and settings.
Vision.missionBody: We believe in the power of stories. Through our visual novels and interactive experiences, we aim to create emotional connections that transcend language and cultural barriers.

gameInfo.title: GAME INFO

synopsis.title: SYNOPSIS
synopsis.p1:
20XX, you've been living as a jobless homebody.
After failing college entrance exams, you've been watching anime in your room as usual.
synopsis.p2:
While communicating with your online girlfriends through the monitor,
you got smacked by your parents and sent to Seoul, moving into a sharehouse with other people.
synopsis.quote: "Told to learn from hardworking people, you start living as a sharehouse member, but upon arrival, three pretty girls are at home...?"
synopsis.char2: The mature but surprisingly charming 'Park Yun-ha'
synopsis.char3: And the cute yet aloof 'Hong Se-eun'.
synopsis.outro: You begin your cohabitation story with three beautiful girls at the sharehouse.
